name: Lu4 Wiki: NPC Gigantic Chaos Golem

links.name: Raid Boss Lv. 1 If the person who made the greatest contribution is 3 or more Lv.s higher than the raid monster, then the item/Adena rewards will decrease. If the difference is 9 or more Lv.s, the monster will drop nothing at all.

Raid Boss Lv. 1 This powerful Chaos Golem was made from Star Stones gathered from the Ruins of Pavel by the mad scientist Dr. Chaos, who styles himself the Emperor of Evil. Once a Golem Maestro, Dr. Chaos was expelled from the Black Anvil Guild for trying to steal the blueprint from the elders. He swore revenge on the Black Anvil Guild, conquering the Ruins of Pavel with the Horrifying Golem Army he created. He views all outsiders as assassins sent by the Guild and will attack immediately. His ultimate goal is 'world domination.'.
